entries.title: Isaiah 12:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: In that day - When this great work of the reduction of Israel, and conversion of the Gentiles is fulfilled.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: God - My salvation hath not been brought to pass by man, but by the almighty power of God.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: With joy - Your thirsty souls shall be filled with Divine graces and comforts, which you may draw from God, in the use of gospel - ordinances.
